title.title: Title
title.description: The heading of the popup, at most 60 characters.

note.title: Note
note.description: One line under the heading, at most 200 characters.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: Shown in this order, at most 20.

label.description: What the button says, at most 60 characters.

when.description: "folder" (a Drive folder is open), "file" (a Doc, Sheet, Slides, Drawing or Drive file is open) or "always".

url.description: An https address; it may contain {folderId} when "folder" or {fileId} when "file".

tab.description: "new" (the default) opens the page in a new tab; "same" opens it in the tab the person is on.
